chandlers.name: The Chandlers' Guild
chandlers.neutral_line: The Chandlers have not decided about you yet.

notices.text: The Chandlers remember. Their ward-lights find you wherever you stand.
The Chandlers remember. Doors in Wickrow shut a little sooner.
The Chandlers are civil to you. Civility, from a guild, is an invoice.

lamplighters.name: The Lamplighters
lamplighters.neutral_line: The Lamplighters know your face and nothing else.

notices.text: The Lamplighters light the far side of the street when you pass.
The Lamplighters leave a lamp burning on your route. Nobody mentions it.
The Lamplighters call you one of the round. You have not agreed to this.

hollow_court.name: The Hollow Court
hollow_court.neutral_line: The Court's file on you is thin, and correctly filed.

notices.text: The Court has your file out on the desk. Out is worse than filed.
The Clerk's stamp comes down a little softer for you.
